source_full: This so enraged the king that he became quite ill, And for many months his life was despaired of. Meanwhile the two elder sisters had married the two friends of the king, And were the mothers of little daughters. Now one day Maria stole secretly to the house where her elder sister lived, and snatching up the children put them into a beautiful basket she had with her, Covered with flowers inside and out, so that no one would ever guess it held two babies.
